npc_hild_widow.name: Hild
npc_hild_widow.look: A small, upright woman in her sixties in black widow's wool with a white apron and cap, grey eyes red from crying, and a wooden spoon in her hand.
npc_hild_widow.personality: Gentle, worn out and stubborn in her own quiet way; loves both sons and can't bear to choose between them.
npc_hild_widow.values: her sons, her late husband's memory, peace at her table
npc_hild_widow.fears: her family breaking apart at her husband's grave
npc_hild_widow.authority: Edric's widow: the farm's mistress while she lives.
npc_hild_widow.concerns: Since Edric was buried a week ago her boys have done nothing but shout. Edric kept a carved box on the dresser that she's never had the heart to open.

box.text: Edric kept letters and papers in the carved box on the dresser; she's never opened it.
box.line: Edric's box, on the dresser. His papers. I can't bring myself to look.
box.lead: Edric's carved box of papers sits unopened on the dresser.

debts.text: Aldo has been paying off Edric's debts to the miller alone, all year, and won't tell Berin.
debts.line: Aldo's paid every penny of his father's debts this year. Alone. He won't have Berin know.
debts.lead: Aldo has secretly paid off his father's debts alone.

npc_hild_widow.persuaded_by: anyone who brings her sons together

samples: Your father would weep to hear you.
There's more to this than either of you knows.
voice.habits: Wipes her hands on her apron; stands between them; feeds people.
voice.greeting: Looks up from the pot: 'Oh. Come in, come in. You'll forgive the shouting.'

npc_hild_widow.likes: a full table, quiet, her sons laughing

tasks.doing: stirring the pot at the hearth

superstition.text: Hild would want to know how it works.

npc_aldo_elder.name: Aldo
npc_aldo_elder.look: A tall, stiff, careful man in his thirties with short fair hair, a lined face older than his years, a plain brown farmer's tunic and big work-roughened hands.
npc_aldo_elder.personality: Proud, dutiful and bitter; stayed and worked while his brother left. Hides hurt as anger.
npc_aldo_elder.fears: losing the farm to debt, being taken for granted
npc_aldo_elder.concerns: Berin came back after three years away and wants half the farm. Aldo has paid their father's debts to the miller alone all year and won't tell anyone, out of pride.

debts.text: He has paid every penny of their father's debts to the miller this year, alone.
debts.line: You want to know? Father owed Gerd the miller forty pennies. I've paid it. Every one. Alone.
debts.lead: Aldo has paid off his father's debts to the miller alone.

berin.text: Berin left three years ago, the week of the harvest, without a word.
berin.line: He walked out at harvest. Three years. Not a word.
berin.lead: Berin left the farm at harvest three years ago.

npc_aldo_elder.persuaded_by: being seen for what he's done; the truth

samples: You don't know what this farm costs.
voice.habits: Folds his arms; won't look at Berin; grips the table edge.
voice.greeting: Nods stiffly: 'We've company. Mind your tongue, Berin.'

npc_aldo_elder.likes: hard work, order, his mother's cooking

npc_hild_widow.text: his mother, worn to a thread

npc_berin_younger.text: a wastrel who ran off and came back for his share

tasks.doing: standing at the near end of the table, arms folded

superstition.text: Aldo would want to know how it works.

npc_berin_younger.name: Berin
npc_berin_younger.look: A handsome, thin young man in his late twenties with untidy dark curls, a threadbare city coat once fine, worn boots, and a quick, defensive smile.
npc_berin_younger.personality: Charming, quick-tempered and ashamed; came home ruined after three years in the city and covers it with swagger.
npc_berin_younger.values: his pride, his mother, being forgiven
npc_berin_younger.fears: being sent away, being found out
npc_berin_younger.authority: None: the younger son, home again.
npc_berin_younger.concerns: He lost everything in the city and has nowhere else to go. He wants a share of the farm because he's frightened, not greedy, and would die before saying so.

ruin.text: He lost every penny in the city and came home with nothing.
ruin.line: ...All right. I lost it. All of it. I came home because there was nowhere else.
ruin.lead: Berin came home ruined from the city.

father.text: Their father once promised him the north field, if he ever came home.
father.line: Father always said the north field was mine, if I came home. He said it.
father.lead: Berin says his father promised him the north field.

npc_berin_younger.persuaded_by: being treated as family, not a beggar

samples: Oh, here we go. Saint Aldo.
I have as much right as he does.
...I didn't know. Why didn't you say?
voice.habits: Paces; jokes when cornered; looks at his mother for help.
voice.greeting: Flashes a smile: 'A visitor! Thank God. Someone sane.'

goals: Have a place at home again
npc_berin_younger.likes: company, a joke, his mother's bread

npc_hild_widow.text: his mother, who always forgave him

npc_aldo_elder.text: a cold, greedy stick who kept everything

tasks.doing: at the far end of the table, too restless to sit

superstition.text: Berin would want to know how it works.
